name: Modal
intro: Root provides context. Keep Backdrop and Positioner beside the trigger inside Root, and place Content inside Positioner. Give the dialog an accessible name through Title or aria-label on Root.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: Root controls whether the dialog is open and sets its size.

props.name: size
props.description: Changes content width and body/title spacing.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state for uncontrolled use.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state; update it after a change callback.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when an open-state change is requested.

props.name: forceAction
props.description: Prevents Escape and outside interaction from dismissing the dialog. Supply an explicit action.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the dialog directly and takes precedence over the Title relationship.

parts.note: The dialog traps focus, prevents background scrolling, and restores focus after closing. These behaviors are managed automatically; the dialog role is fixed to dialog.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: Opens the dialog and accepts Button styling props.

data.purpose: Style the open and closed states.

parts.name: Backdrop
parts.description: Covers the page behind the dialog. Clicking it closes the dialog when forceAction is false.

data.purpose: Style the open and closed states.
Style the open and closed states.

parts.name: Content
parts.description: Holds the dialog content. Use Title or aria-label on Root to name the dialog.

data.purpose: Style the open and closed states.

parts.name: Title
parts.description: Names the dialog. Put a heading inside it at the appropriate page level.

parts.name: Description
parts.description: Provides an optional description for the dialog.

parts.name: Body
parts.description: Spacing responds to Root's size variant.

parts.name: CloseTrigger
parts.description: Closes the dialog. The default icon button is named "Close this window."

accessibility: The dialog manages focus, labeling, and closed-state visibility. Provide a useful title or label, meaningful action names, and an explicit way to finish a forced-action dialog.
